P4-GAP-001.current_formula: line_subtotal = quantity * unit_price (Barcode/SKU resolved at runtime via relationship)
P4-GAP-001.conflicting_formula: Expected immutable historical point-in-time barcode snapshot in sale_items table
P4-GAP-001.inventory_impact: Barcode lookup failure on obsolete product lines
P4-GAP-001.reporting_impact: Reprinted invoices show altered barcodes if master changes

P4-GAP-002.current_formula: PUT /sales/{id} updates sales.customer_id with 0 Khata ledger compensation
P4-GAP-002.financial_impact: Permanent AR ledger divergence between customers.balance cache and statement event sums
P4-GAP-002.reporting_impact: Distorts aging reports and customer statements

P4-GAP-003.current_formula: paid_amount = SUM(tender_inputs) stored in single header column
P4-GAP-003.conflicting_formula: Persist individual payment_records linking tender amount to specific account_id
P4-GAP-003.financial_impact: Bank reconciliation and shift drawer cash balances cannot independently verify split payments
P4-GAP-003.reporting_impact: Financial account deposit reports omit split card payments

P4-GAP-004.current_formula: created_at = client_device_timestamp adopted without drift guard
P4-GAP-004.financial_impact: Daily sales aggregates and shift cash totals distorted across calendar days
P4-GAP-004.inventory_impact: Inventory movement ledger records inserted out of chronological order

P4-GAP-005.financial_impact: COGS understated, gross profit overstated, inventory asset valuation on balance sheet understated
P4-GAP-005.inventory_impact: Product cost price remains lower than actual landed acquisition cost

P4-GAP-006.current_formula: Missing Purchase Return / Supplier Debit Note entity and formula
P4-GAP-006.financial_impact: Supplier payables frequently fail to reflect returned defective merchandise credits
P4-GAP-006.inventory_impact: Manual stock adjustments used as workaround obscure supplier defect tracking
P4-GAP-006.reporting_impact: No debit note documentation generated for vendor reconciliation

P4-GAP-007.financial_impact: Erroneous supplier payment entries require manual dual-sided database/account corrections
P4-GAP-007.reporting_impact: Supplier statement reflects erroneous payment until manual adjustment

P4-GAP-008.conflicting_formula: if (!item.is_damaged) { branch_inventory += qty } else { quarantine_inventory += qty }
P4-GAP-008.financial_impact: Overvalues sellable inventory assets by carrying unsellable damaged goods at full cost price
P4-GAP-008.inventory_impact: Damaged returned items immediately re-enter sellable stock on hand
P4-GAP-008.reporting_impact: Inventory reports count damaged returns as sellable stock

P4-GAP-009.financial_impact: Cancels supplier AP liability while revenue from sold stock remains recognized
P4-GAP-009.inventory_impact: Forces quantity_on_hand into negative numbers in database
P4-GAP-009.reporting_impact: Stock valuation shows negative asset values for affected SKU

P4-GAP-010.current_formula: cancelSale reverses cash register; skips financial_account.balance decrement on bank sales
P4-GAP-010.financial_impact: Financial account bank balance in system remains inflated after a bank-paid sale is voided
P4-GAP-010.reporting_impact: Bank reconciliation reports diverge from actual bank account balance

P4-GAP-012.current_formula: source_stock -= qty; dest_stock += qty [Synchronous single transaction]
P4-GAP-012.conflicting_formula: source_stock -= qty; in_transit_stock += qty; ... on receipt: dest_stock += qty
P4-GAP-012.financial_impact: Branch-level inventory asset valuation immediately shifts before physical arrival
P4-GAP-012.inventory_impact: Destination POS operators can sell stock that is still physically on a truck in transit
P4-GAP-012.reporting_impact: Branch stock reports show stock present before delivery confirmation

P4-GAP-013.current_formula: Expense creation permits financial_account_id = null on cash expense
P4-GAP-013.financial_impact: Expense recognized in P&L with no reduction in either cash drawer or bank accounts
P4-GAP-013.reporting_impact: P&L expenses diverge from balance sheet asset outflows

P4-GAP-014.current_formula: Offline POS cart does not re-price line items when wholesale customer selected after scan
P4-GAP-014.conflicting_formula: Reactive cart watcher recalculates all item prices upon customer attachment
P4-GAP-014.financial_impact: Wholesale customer overcharged at retail price; requires credit note adjustment
P4-GAP-014.reporting_impact: Sales revenue recorded at retail rate rather than contractual wholesale rate

P4-GAP-015.current_formula: Customer payment reversal increases customer balance; leaves individual sales marked PAID
P4-GAP-015.conflicting_formula: Re-allocate unpaid status and due_amount to individual sales invoices FIFO
P4-GAP-015.financial_impact: Discrepancy between total customer outstanding balance and sum of open sale invoice due amounts
P4-GAP-015.reporting_impact: Customer account shows debt while specific invoice view indicates fully paid

P4-GAP-016.current_formula: Taxable base = subtotal - discount_amount (tax computed after discount deduction)
P4-GAP-016.conflicting_formula: In certain jurisdictions tax applies to pre-discount subtotal
P4-GAP-016.financial_impact: Tax liability differs if tax authority mandates pre-discount taxation
P4-GAP-016.reporting_impact: Tax report reflects discounted base taxation
